rv.q: I found my mind wandering even as I was once again impressed by director Frédérique Michel's visually striking staging and by City Garage's embrace of absurdist (and more specifically European) theater that would otherwise go unseen by L.A audiences.
This is a problematic play that is, at times, very difficult to follow.
Honestly this production is among the most powerful I have ever seen from them, which please believe is very high praise indeed.
